Title: Trap and "cannot use presses to continue" (and Petra)

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Mukhtar Bey cannot use presses to continue.
Can he (or, for that matter, someone under Terror Frenzy) play Trap?
Trap supplies the presses itself (and either minion can press to end against
it), so it looks like it should be OK.

If a minion opposing Petra in combat plays Trap, do they suffer the loss of
blood during the press step? Again, it's the Trap that's the source of the
presses, so I'd say they do not lose anything.
